# IRODA

> IRODA (Intelligent Reasoning for Office Decisions and Actions) is an open-source Hungarian enterprise benchmark for large language models (LLMs) and AI agents. It measures whether a model or agent finds the right business records in a simulated Hungarian company, carries out the requested action accurately through Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, and leaves every other record unchanged. A deterministic grader scores each trial with no judge model. "Iroda" is also the Hungarian word for "office"; this file is about the benchmark.

Status: version 0.1.0 preview with two public starter cases. No leaderboard has been published yet. The code and data are MIT licensed. Benchmark prompts and tool names are in Hungarian.

## Methodology

- [Módszertan (Hungarian)](https://www.irodabench.hu/modszertan/): run modes, grading rules, worked grading examples and limitations
- [Methodology (English)](https://www.irodabench.hu/en/methodology/): the same page in English
- [Full measurement methodology](https://github.com/iroda-bench/iroda-bench/blob/main/docs/methodology.en.md): reproducibility and reporting requirements
